messages.text: I’ll read the updated wording before making changes.

The updated sketch moves the inter-coil B1 chambers inward between the BT legs, while keeping the coil-plane chambers at their current radius. That differs from the blocked below-coil placement.

I’ll test that pattern and a half-sector offset for B2, with fresh clearance checks and a before/after coverage comparison.

The updated comment also says to rotate the “middle stations” by half a sector. Should the 7.5° rotation apply only to middle barrel layer B2, or also to both middle endcap wheels? I can develop the inner-barrel stagger while this is clarified.
- Middle barrel B2 only
- B2 and both middle endcap wheels

I’m treating “middle stations” as barrel layer B2 while the scope clarification is open. Its chamber pitch is 15°, so a 7.5° rotation separates the edges; a 15° rotation would align them again.

I’m also checking HCAL service routes when choosing the inward B1 radius, since they extend beyond the calorimeter cover.
The Spack preflight flags changed setup and lockfile fingerprints. I’ll reverify the activated runtime and existing ACTS binaries before using them for exports and crossing checks.

The inward stagger has a narrow feasible range: 4.625–4.645 m apothem under the current clearance rules. I’m using 4.630 m, which leaves 55 mm to the known water-jacket reservation and 35.3 mm between neighboring chamber envelopes.

That service bound belongs to an ECAL egress design reservation. Complete external HCAL routing remains unqualified.

The new packing clears the fixed coils and frame. B1 stays at 96 chambers; rotating B2 requires more cuts around the hardware, increasing B2 from 168 to 216 chambers and the total from 888 to 936.

I’ll now generate the blue/grey OBJ and compare coverage on the same direction bank to measure both gains and losses.

The OBJ and before/after views are generated, and the native ACTS corners match the source prisms. The interface check also confirms why B2 needs extra pieces: all 24 rotated full-length templates cross existing endcap-toroid or frame reservations, so those corridors must stay open.

The field-map smoke check and coverage comparison are still running.

The combined layout improves the full-sphere three-station border proxy from 57.77% to 59.09%, with 5,608 directions gained and 4,745 lost. The B2 rotation alone hurts that strict metric; the inward B1 stagger recovers directions in the combined layout.

All 1,024 zero-field ACTS tracks match the finite-prism predictions. The field-map smoke check retains 59 masked tracks out of 256. I’ll have the frozen artifacts independently checked before publishing.

The artifacts are frozen for independent review, including the ray bank, native crossings, OBJ exports and source hashes. The report preserves the tradeoffs: 48 extra B2 pieces, 15 barrel size families, local coverage losses and open service-routing requirements.

The spacing calculation puts B2 closer to the midpoint between the first and third crossings, but the span still varies by direction. For directions accepted in both layouts, the median chord grows from 3.68 m to 4.18 m. The report keeps this separate from momentum resolution.

The independent calculation reproduces the coverage gains and losses, spacing distributions, and all 437,580 chamber-pair checks. It also confirms that the retained entrance boundary precedes every chamber. The native-event and export checks are still being finalized.

The review found one stale scope label: an inherited sentence described all geometric fractions as central-barrel results. I’ve corrected it to distinguish the central bank from the full-sphere bank. The scientific results and raw artifacts are unchanged; that correction is getting a separate check.
The independent review is complete, including the scope-label correction. I’m replaying the final checker, then I’ll publish the updated PR description, reviewer reply, drawings and OBJ downloads.

The updated layout and OBJ downloads are published on PR #90, and I’ve replied to the reviewer. I’m verifying the published links and closing the project records; the commit leaves the magnetic field and endcap wheels unchanged.

Addressed the updated sketch and [replied on PR #90](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6291082626).

- Inter-coil B1 moved inward to 4.63 m; barrel B2 rotated 7.5°.
- Updated OBJ and drawings: 936 chamber outlines.
- Geometry checks and 1,024 ACTS tracks pass.
- Three-station geometric coverage: 57.77% → 59.09%, with local losses documented.

Endcap wheels and field map remain unchanged. Independent review is complete; CI is running.
